summary.text: Loeffler describes AI as supporting business formation, industrial hiring, and competitiveness. She says AI improves small-business productivity and helps smaller firms compete with larger businesses. She presents the Ratepayer Protection Pledge as allowing Americans to benefit from U.S. AI dominance without higher utility costs. She calls winning the AI race vital to continued American dominance in defense, innovation, and economic strength.
